messages.subject: shinyStan freezing with grey screen
parts:
I found during a demo that shinyStan went all grey and stopped
responding.  
> Here's what the terminal said when it wasn't working:
>
> > source("lr-shiny.R")
>
> Listening on http://127.0.0.1:5787
> Error in .Call("R_fromJSON", content, as.integer(sum(simplify)), nullValue,  :
>   "R_fromJSON" not resolved from current namespace (RJSONIO)
> Error in .Call("R_fromJSON", content, as.integer(sum(simplify)), nullValue,  :
>   "R_fromJSON" not resolved from current namespace (RJSONIO)
> Error in .Call("R_fromJSON", content, as.integer(sum(simplify)), nullValue,  :
>   "R_fromJSON" not resolved from current namespace (RJSONIO)
> Error in .Call("R_fromJSON", content, as.integer(sum(simplify)), nullValue,  :
>   "R_fromJSON" not resolved from current namespace (RJSONIO)

Jonah wrote back:

> On Mar 26, 2015, at 1:12 AM, Jonah Sol Gabry <jga...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Thanks Bob, that's helpful. I've seen similar error messages before (not often but maybe once or twice a few months ago) and there's even a mention of it on the troubleshooting page of the shinyStan wiki here. Unfortunately I was never able to intentionally reproduce the error, so the only recommendation I could give on the troubleshooting page is to restart R, which cleared up the issue every time I had it.
>
> In fact, I did a search and found a few other people dealing with this issue with Shiny and RJSONIO. There's even a response from Winston Chang (one of the developers of Shiny), who thinks it's a bug in RJSONIO and he also just recommends restarting R.

I thought it'd be worth posting here (with Jonah's permission)
to give people a heads-up as to what might go wrong and why.

- Bob
